description: Manually run the AI enrichment agent over existing articles (classification, keywords, entities, quality scoring). RESTRICTED to platform-team accounts — requires a WorkOS bearer token issued inside the platform-team org. By default enriches the most recent un-enriched articles; pass article_ids to target specific ones, or reset_attempts to re-run articles that previously hit the failure cap.

article_ids.description: Specific article IDs to (re)enrich (optional). Capped at 50.

limit.description: How many un-enriched articles to enqueue, 1–50 (default 25). Ignored when article_ids is given.

reset_attempts.description: Re-enrich even articles that already hit the failure cap (default false). Use sparingly — it re-bills AI.

name: trigger_enrichment
